meta_desc: NebuLink Node NLN500a — compact STM32WL based LoRaWAN node (16 x 32.6 x 3.5 mm), EU863-870/IN865 MHz, -135 dBm sensitivity, +20 dBm output, up to 10 km LoS, AES-256.
desc: NebuLink Node NLN500a is a compact and powerful node for LoRa applications. It is designed around the STM32WL — the world's first wireless microcontroller to integrate a LoRa transceiver — and enriched with multiple serial interfaces, digital and analog I/Os and on-chip memory to perform any IoT operation. It integrates easily into any LoRa based network.
tagline: Compact STM32WL based LoRaWAN node — 16 × 32.6 mm, −135 dBm sensitivity (SF12), up to 10 km line of sight.

overview: NebuLink Node NLN500a is Nebulae's compact LoRaWAN node, designed using the STM32WL — the world's first wireless microcontroller to integrate a LoRa transceiver. A single ARM Cortex-M4 SoC handles both the application and the radio, keeping the module small and the design simple.

With 256 KB of flash and 64 KB of RAM, multiple serial interfaces (2 × SPI, 3 × I2C, 2 × USART and 1 × LPUART), up to 43 digital inputs and outputs and analog inputs, the NLN500a has the resources to perform a wide range of IoT operations.

The node is built for low-power deployments: an ultra low power design that runs from a 1.8 V to 3.6 V supply, LoRa modulation with sensitivity down to −135 dBm (SF12), output power up to +20 dBm and an estimated line-of-sight range of up to 10,000 m. Hardware AES-256 encryption and a true random number generator support secure communication, and the module is pre-certified according to EN 300 220.
overview_note: * Estimated based on ideal conditions with limited sources of interference.
